title: Instructions for Form 8960 (2025), Net Investment Income Tax

passages.question: Do the Whitfords owe the net investment income tax?
passages.excerpt: Individuals who have for the tax year (a) MAGI that's over an applicable threshold amount, and (b) NII, must pay 3.8% of the smaller of (a) or (b) as their NIIT ... Married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse is $250,000.
